entries.profile_scope: DATA-03 strict Chinese SRT matched-media admission
entries.expected_invariant: Every cue in a claimed matched-media scene must end within a verified duration of that same media item; strict SRT syntax alone does not establish alignment.
entries.last_outcome: Pinned 271-cue strict SRT exceeds the Commons-listed 12:18 video by eight cues under a conservative 12:19 upper bound. The original is excluded from matched-media use; a mapped derivative and actual stream check remain unperformed.
